offering_description.value: Provides digital and print learning content, courseware and assessment tools for K-12, higher education and professional learners. Sells to schools, districts, colleges, students and professionals through adaptive learning platforms and textbooks.

primary_products.value: digital courseware and learning platforms; textbooks and print materials; K-12 curriculum programs; assessment and test prep materials; professional reference books

primary_services.value: online homework and assessment delivery; adaptive learning subscriptions; professional development and training; language learning

customer_segment.value: B2B: colleges and universities, private schools, professional learners and institutions; B2G: public school districts and state education agencies; B2C: students and individuals buying course materials and subscriptions

end_markets.value: K-12 education; higher education; professional education; language learning

revenue_model.value: subscription: digital courseware, platform and inclusive access fees; product sales: textbooks, print curriculum and reference materials; licensing or royalties: content licensing to institutions and partners
revenue_model.category: subscription; product sales; licensing or royalties

specialization.value: related lines: K-12 curriculum, higher education courseware, professional content and assessment

distribution_channels.category: direct sales; online; third-party retail; distributors / dealers
